hints.content: The $y$-intercept occurs when $x$ is $0$. Let's determine the significance of this point.
In this case, $x$ represents years from now. So the $y$-intercept occurs $0$ years from now.
$0$ years from now, Benjamin has $\$400$ in savings.

question.content:
Benjamin invests $\$400$ in a savings account that earns $5\%$ interest each year.  He graphs his savings (in dollars) over $x$ years.

**What is the significance of the $y$-intercept of this graph?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: $0$ years from now, Benjamin has $\$400$ in savings.
$1$ year from now, Benjamin has $\$400$ in savings.
$1$ year from now, Benjamin has $\$420$ in savings.
$0$ years from now, Benjamin has $\$420$ in savings.
